datasets.help: Per data row its columns, each column of a row described individually under keys. Incomplete rows are kept but not plotted; instance.set replaces the whole list. Clear it with one empty row ([{ valueRef: null, groupRef: null }]); [] is rejected.

valueRef.label: V
valueRef.title: Value column (numeric)
valueRef.help: The value column of the row (slot V), numeric with at least two values, and required. Without it the row is kept but not plotted. Empty until one is chosen.

groupRef.label: G
groupRef.title: Grouping (categorical)
groupRef.help: The group column of the row (slot G), optional; it splits the row into series, one per group value. Empty until one is chosen.

distribution.help: The distribution the plot checks against. It is fixed to the normal distribution and cannot be changed: if the points lie close to the dashed line, the series fits a normal distribution. There is no goodness-of-fit test with a test value.

stats.help: Per plotted series its statistics, confidence intervals and reference line, structured like modules.shared.types.SeriesStats; series hidden in the chart editor are left out. null while nothing can be computed.

activeColumnSlots.help: The slot keys a row of the datasets carries: valueRef, groupRef.

showStats.help: Show or hide the statistics per series below the chart.

confLevel.help: The confidence level in percent, greater than 0 (for example 95). It determines the confidence intervals in the statistics table.

legacySeries.help: Display settings from older saved states, one entry per series by position (name, colour, line colour, symbol, size, border, visibility). They apply before the chart editor settings and are cleared as soon as the data rows change. Not meant to be set by hand.

series.help: The series built from the data rows (name, values, visibility), or an object with “error” and “params” when no series can be built.

shown.help: The series after the chart editor settings. Empty while there are no series; series hidden in the editor are included but not visible.

SeriesStats.referenceLine: The dashed line of this series, labelled “— Fit” in the legend. It passes through the points at the first and third quartile. Empty while the series has fewer than two values.

ReferenceLine.slope: The slope of the line: how much the normal quantile (the vertical axis, labelled as a probability in percent) rises per unit of the measured value (the horizontal axis). It is positive and larger the more tightly the values are packed; roughly it is the inverse of the spread.
ReferenceLine.intercept: The intercept of the line: the normal quantile at a measured value of 0. Together with the slope, normal quantile = slope · value + intercept; the line crosses the 50 percent level where the value equals minus intercept divided by slope, roughly at the mean.

clearLegacySeries.help: Discards the display settings from older saved states. Runs by itself when the data rows change.

params.command: The command as an object without parameters.
